_note: Fraction of list price retained by age (index = years). Market-style curves used conservatively as the vehicle's value as mobility; MML fleet-internal value may be higher because normal use is priced in.

ice.rationale: European C-segment petrol residual band, 0–15 years; to be replaced by a used-market curve

hev.rationale: full-hybrid band, slightly stronger than petrol on the used market; to be replaced by a used-market curve

bev.rationale: BEV band, steeper first years reflecting 2024–2026 used-market pricing; to be replaced by a used-market curve

kmAdjustmentPer5000.rationale: 2% per 5,000 km above or below reference

componentRetention.rationale: share of list price recoverable as components by age; chapter 4 hierarchy, no market series exists

materialValuePerKg.rationale: net of dismantling and processing, steel/aluminium/copper mix

materialCapitalFloorShare.rationale: chapter 2.5 leaves the method open; 90% of material retention value is one method, labelled
